beliefs: f(x) = g(x) + 'JTQL' for every input including the empty string [E1, E7, E8]
g shifts only the first character of the input by -2 in the alphabet (lowercase a->y, uppercase A->Y), leaving the rest unchanged [E1, E2, E3, E4]
The first-character shift wraps around: a->y, b->z, c->a, z->x [E1, E2]
Digits, symbols, spaces, and all non-first characters are unchanged [E1, E3, E4, E6]
The empty string maps to 'H' then the suffix, giving 'HTQL' [E7, E8]
notes: E8 shows the empty string also gets the 'JTQL' suffix, so 'H' is just the shifted/placeholder body; removed the special-case that dropped the suffix for empty input.
